setup.title: Set up your assistant
setup.description: The assistant needs to be enabled by your administrator and have at least one model available. Then follow these three steps.
setup.connectDescription: Add your own key or use Credits where available.
setup.memberConnectDescription: An admin chooses Credits or adds a shared key. In own-key mode, you can also use a personal key for chat.
setup.memberLimitsDescription: View the project limit. Ask an admin if it needs to change.
setup.limitsDescription: Choose a spending limit that works for this project.
setup.startDescription: Check the setup, then choose a model and ask your first question.
setup.ready: Assistant is ready. You can start a conversation.
setup.notReady: Assistant is not ready. Check the AI provider connection and administrator settings.
setup.checkFailed: Could not check setup. Try again.
